title: Find Primer-Pair Markers for PATZ1 Isoforms

graphics.caption: G1: compare 13 Ensembl design transcripts with four RefSeq records without silently merging their target sets.
G2: review the all-annotated-cDNA, minimal-discrimination request and explicit best-effort policy before design.
G3: seven selected pairs cover 13 cDNA classes but leave nine class pairs unresolved; inspect both oligos and the product matrix.
G4: the separate study plan remains unexecuted and must not claim the exploratory panel as its result.
G5: local cDNA products do not establish whole-reference specificity; the selected pair remains unassessed.
G6: export controls await an explicit publication request and destination; this is not evidence of a completed dossier export.

catalog.notes: Find candidate PATZ1 isoform markers, not a unique assay for every transcript. G1-G3 compare pinned Ensembl 116/RefSeq annotations, review a SYBR minimal-discrimination request and interpret coverage versus unresolved cDNA-class pairs. RefSeq is comparison context; no five-pair budget, UniProt prioritization or expression/junction evidence is supplied. G4-G6 optionally inspect the separate unexecuted study, readiness blockers and pending dossier export. Retained G1-G6 Linux captures are bound to 3c1c32bc (2026-09-20), not current-candidate or live-agent acceptance. Codex source review 2026-09-30 covers readability, controls and command applicability; whole-reference specificity and human scientific approval remain pending.
